title: Pet Friendly Private Suite Near Downtown
description:
Private pet-friendly 2BR suite in Nashville with a full bath, living room, dining area, and easy parking. Guests love the spotless accommodations, simple check-in, and comfortable atmosphere. Perfect for couples, families, friends, and travelers with dogs.

The space
This private guest suite offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and privacy in a quiet Nashville neighborhood. The space includes two queen bedrooms, a full bath, a comfortable living room, and a dining area with a full kitchen table, coffee station, mini refrigerator, nugget ice maker, and microwave.

Guests have their own private entrance and enjoy a separate, dedicated space while I live on-site in a completely separate area. This arrangement provides privacy while allowing me to be available if you need anything during your stay.

Well-behaved pets are welcome, and the neighborhood is great for walks. Conveniently located near I-40, downtown Nashville, shopping, restaurants, and local attractions, the suite makes an excellent home base for exploring Music City.

Guest access
Guests have a private entrance and full access to the entire guest suite, including two bedrooms, a full bathroom, living room, dining area, coffee station, microwave, and mini refrigerator.

Self check-in is easy using a secure lockbox located at the private entrance.

The guest suite is completely separate from the owner-occupied portion of the home, allowing guests to enjoy privacy while knowing assistance is available if needed.

Other things to note
•Broadway and downtown Nashville are typically a 15–20 minute drive away.
• Free driveway parking is available.
• Pets are welcome with a pet fee.
• The host lives on-site in a separate private area of the home.
• Guests have a private entrance and exclusive use of the guest suite.
